subject: Fortivio SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist — onboarding plan & MAP
body:
From: Alice Hsu <alice.hsu@fortivio.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fortivio SSO / SCIM onboarding & IP allowlist

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for taking this on. We’re ready to start the enterprise onboarding for Fortivio. Top priorities for us:
- SSO (SAML) with automatic user provisioning (SCIM)
- IP allowlist for production API endpoints (we restrict egress to a small set of ranges)
- Dedicated service account patterns (we require non-human service identities, short-lived keys where possible)
- A clear rollback/cutover plan and runbook for staged cutover (staging -> prod)

We need these in place for our security review next month. Can you send a mutual action plan and a technical checklist so our infra team can sign off? Also, our security team requested the Fortivio SOC2 scope — I’ll attach the current copy.

Proposed kickoff window: Wed 21 Mar or Thu 22 Mar, 90 minutes (technical + config review).

Thanks —
Alice Hsu
Head of IT Operations
Fortivio

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Hsu <alice.hsu@fortivio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fortivio SSO / SCIM onboarding & IP allowlist

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear priorities. I’ve attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a high-level SSO topology diagram for the kickoff. Quick summary / proposed approach:

1) Kickoff & discovery (90m) — walk through Fortivio identity model, SCIM attributes required, and IP whitelist constraints.
2) Pre-prod config — we’ll provision a staging tenant and provide test SAML metadata + SCIM endpoints.
3) Service accounts & keys — recommend dedicated service identities per environment; we can support short-lived tokens and rotate certs via KMS integration.
4) Cutover & rollback — staged cutover with canary, smoke tests, and automated rollback triggers if provisioning failures exceed threshold.

Action items for kickoff (to confirm on call):
- Fortivio to share SAML IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, cert) for staging and prod.
- Fortivio to provide SCIM attribute mapping doc (email, externalId, groups) and provisioning rules.
- Fortivio to confirm IP ranges for allowlisting and CIDR notation.
- Redwood to share service account creation flow and temporary key rotation cadence.

I’ve CC’d Monica (technical lead for onboarding) and Ben (CS ops) to handle the config and scheduling. Monica — can you review the attached MAP and add any infra prerequisites? Ben — can you create the HubSpot task and calendar invite?

Attachments: Fortivio_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, sso-topology.png

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Lead, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

---

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Fortivio technical checklist (pre-kickoff)

Priyom / Ben —

I reviewed the MAP and sketched a conservative technical checklist we should cover on the call. I’m pasting it below so we have a single reference and can send it to Fortivio ahead of the meeting. I’ll also add it to the shared MAP doc (linked).

Monica’s Pre-kickoff Tech Checklist:
- SAML / IdP
  - Confirm entityID and ACS URL for staging + prod
  - Confirm assertion signing cert algorithm (RSA SHA256) and cert rotation window
  - Attribute mappings: email -> email, username -> externalId (confirm length limits), groups -> groupMembership
  - SLO / Logout URL? (optional)
- SCIM provisioning
  - SCIM base URL and bearer token format for staging/prod
  - Supported operations: POST / PATCH / DELETE; handling of duplicates
  - Rate limits and retry guidance (we will batch writes during sync)
  - Group sync strategy (nested groups supported?)
- IP allowlist
  - Fortivio to provide source IP ranges used for on-prem egress and any fixed NAT ranges (CIDR)
  - We will expose public endpoints; confirm if Fortivio wants IP-level allowlist on our API edge or via VPC peering (private deployments)
- Service accounts
  - Recommend non-human principal per integration (staging, prod, monitoring)
  - Key rotation window: suggest 30-day rotation for long-lived keys or use short-lived tokens (recommended)
  - Scopes: provisioning-only vs admin-provisioning; need principle of least privilege mapping
- org policies & audit
  - Logs required: provisioning logs (who/when), SAML assertion failures, SCIM response payloads (redact PII)
  - Retention: Fortivio default? we can map to 90/365 day retention buckets
- Cutover plan
  - Dry-run in staging with 50 test users (canary) -> smoke tests (login + provisioning) -> schedule 2-hour maintenance window for prod cutover
  - Rollback: disable provisioning push, revert to manual mapping, revoke newly created service tokens

I’ll prepare a short runbook excerpt for the staging dry-run so Fortivio’s infra team can exercise it. Also recommend we ask security@fortivio for the list of IPs and any firewall change lead time.

Monica Patel
Senior Onboarding Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks,
Ben Carter
